text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: P0 - Unexpected metering telemetry delta detected. Multiple customers reporting delayed usage and anomalous billable-unit spikes. Auto-page sent to oncall.
Sam (oncall): saw it. paging now. any immediate customer-facing impact?
Pranav (SRE): I’m on it — starting runbook: check incoming event queue lag, aggregation worker stats, and upstream ingestion time skew.
Sam (oncall): thx. ping me when you have a quick summary.
Pranav (SRE): first glance: ingestion pipeline latency normal, but the aggregator's sequence window has reprocessed batches from 03:50-03:55 UTC and produced duplicated delta counts for some customers. suspect race in dedupe window after recent deploy.
Maya (Billing): we’re seeing overage flags firing for ~12 accounts in prod; billing alert TTL is 10m so some customers may have provisional overage emails. Can we pause overage emitter?
Olivia (Platform): I can flip the emitter to dry-run mode. doing: `./deploy-toggle --service=overage-emitter --mode=dry-run` -> ok queued.
Pranav (SRE): quick mitigation: pause aggregator commit step to stop writing duplicate deltas, then run a lightweight reconcile to collapse duplicates. Command I’m running: ```
# pause writes
kubectl scale deploy aggregator-write -n prod --replicas=0
# run reconcile (dry-run first)
python tools/reconcile_counts.py --since=2024-11-03T03:40:00Z --dry-run
```
Sam (oncall): neat. Maya, can you hold customer comms until we know scope?
Maya (Billing): yes. will hold. already rolled back provisional overage emails where possible. contacting CS for queued tickets.
billing-bot: New overage event: acct=acme-inc flag=overage provisional=true generated at 2024-11-03T03:52:21Z
Pranav (SRE): reconcile dry-run shows duplicated delta for acme-inc (delta +42k tokens duplicated, actual should be +4.2k). root cause looks like aggregator checkpoint wrote twice after crash recovery window.
Olivia (Platform): note: last deploy to aggregator at 2024-11-03T03:30Z. rolling back to previous image (v1.6.2) now: `fluxctl rollback aggregator 1`.
Kevin (Product): customers impacted list? anything enterprise-class? if invoices already issued we need corrective path.
Maya (Billing): impacted accounts list: acme-inc, pixie-ai, dataworks-sv, and 9 smaller accounts. none have final invoices yet (billing run not executed), but overage flags triggered in UI and emails (some sent).
Sam (oncall): status update in 10. also please tag any legal/compliance if refunds might be necessary.
Pranav (SRE): rollback initiated. FSM shows aggregator pods terminating; standup of v1.6.2 in progress. once stable we'll re-run reconcile in non-dry-run to correct stored counts and then re-enable emitter.
Olivia (Platform): rollback complete, health checks green. running smoke: `curl -sS https://internal-agg/probe/health` -> OK.
Pranav (SRE): non-dry reconcile started: `python tools/reconcile_counts.py --since=2024-11-03T03:40:00Z` logs: ```
INFO: reconcile: acme-inc duplicate=38000 corrected=1
INFO: reconcile: pixie-ai duplicate=22000 corrected=1
INFO: reconcile: dataworks-sv duplicate=11200 corrected=1
INFO: reconcile: total_corrected=9 accounts
``` 
Maya (Billing): verifying downstream: UI flags cleared for first 6 accounts. I’ll watch DMARC bounce reports for emailed overages and coordinate rescinds where needed.
billing-bot: Overage emitter mode changed -> dry-run by Olivia (Platform)
Kevin (Product): need a short incident blurb for status page: one sentence + impact counts.
Sam (oncall): draft: "We detected a metering aggregation issue that temporarily caused duplicated usage deltas for a small set of customers. We've rolled back the aggregator, corrected affected records, and prevented further overage notifications. No final invoices were issued."
Kevin (Product): LGTM. include timeline and mitigation steps later.
Pranav (SRE): root cause postmortem note: race in aggregator commit after restart under backpressure; dedupe window not durable across restarts. action: add durable checkpointing and safety guard to emitter.
Olivia (Platform): creating task in infra backlog: `INFRA-789` -> add transactional commit + idempotency keys.
Maya (Billing): follow-up: will run a billing reconciliation tomorrow to confirm totals, and prepare credit/rescind process if any customers received charges. I’ll prepare customer outreach templates.
Sam (oncall): closing loop: emitter set back to live after reconcile ?
Olivia (Platform): re-enabled emitter to live at 2024-11-03T04:18Z. monitoring for new anomalies.
incident-bot: Incident status -> RESOLVED (mitigations applied, publisher resumed). Duration ~48m.
Pranav (SRE): will post a short postmortem draft to #postmortems and tag eng/runtime and billing for review.
Maya (Billing): thanks everyone. I’ll coordinate CS messages if any customers escalate.
Sam (oncall): nice work. follow-ups captured: INFRA-789, POSTMORTEM-1824123456, Billing reconciliation job scheduled.
Kevin (Product): add product impact note: standby for any SLA adjustments. :thumbsup:
